material.description: origin/main 9bf4db69 js/client/swap_protocol.js defines packSwapKind twice (image-aware copy at line 28, one-arg copy at line 38). The bundle step rejects the duplicate export. The one-arg copy came from stash port 4adc0816; the image-aware copy is the one play.js packKindOf calls with (file, image) and is in the initial squash. Fix: remove the one-arg copy, keep the image-aware copy, move its comment above it.
material.resolution: duplicate one-argument packSwapKind removed; image-aware live definition kept; pages bundle step green.
